content.text:
I fixed the crash. It happened whenever the input source map had no `sourcesContent` field: the trace-mapping library then leaves `sourcesContent` undefined, and `@babel/generator` was indexing into it without checking.

The fix is one line in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts`:

```ts
this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i] ?? null,
```

If there's no content for a source, the generator now passes `null` (the type the gen-mapping library expects) instead of crashing. After rebuilding, I ran the generator with an input map that has no `sourcesContent`, like the one in the issue. It produced a map with `sourcesContent: [null]` instead of throwing. I didn't run the existing test suite or add a regression test.
